windstormCounty.note: Galveston County is a whole-county TDI designated catastrophe area; League City is listed as Inland I. The Inland I/II line in Galveston County follows the Brazoria/Galveston county line north from SH 6 to Friendswood's southern limits, then Friendswood's eastern limits to the Harris County line - it is NOT tied to I-45, so all of League City (Galveston part) is Inland I. A small part of League City lies in Harris County (Harris designation covers only La Porte/Seabrook/Shoreacres/Morgan's Point/Pasadena east of SH 146) - verify those parcels. plainLanguage: All of League City's Galveston County area is in the state's 'Inland I' windstorm zone, so every new house needs a Texas Department of Insurance windstorm certificate (WPI-8) - there is no I-45 dividing line. That means a TDI-appointed engineer reviews the plans and inspects during construction, and windows, doors and roof connections must meet higher wind ratings. Since April 1, 2026, TDI checks windstorm work against the 2024 IRC. We could not confirm League City's own code edition, setbacks, flood rule or fees in this research pass; treat those as unknown and confirm with the city.
